records.name: Unlock the Collectibles Chest
records.summary: Get the 1,000-slot stash for quest items, lore notes and recipe books early, before the inventory fills up.

steps.text: Cross to the north bank of the Nas River in Hernand.
Find the Timberturner Wainwright and take the Early Encounter quest.
Finish the errand; the chest is available from then on.

records.notes: Recipe books and lore go to the chest automatically once it is unlocked.

sources.title: TheGamer: wardrobe, gatherables and collectible chests
